contradictions.source: از پس شصت سال کز تو گذشت · چون توانی بزیر پای نوشت
contradictions.english: After sixty years have passed for you | How are you able to walk beneath your feet?
contradictions.why: The source asks how he can write/inscribe (نوشت) beneath his feet, not walk.

contradictions.source: از چنین پایه مانده کی گردم
contradictions.english: How could I remain from such a base?
contradictions.why: The source asks how he could be left behind/remain (مانده) from such a height/base, not how he could remain from it.

contradictions.source: شه چو سرهنگش این حکایت گفت
contradictions.english: When the King heard this tale from his colonel
contradictions.why: The source says the King told the tale to his colonel (sarehang), not that he heard it from him.
